project_type: Next.js 14+ App Router full-stack web application
build_system: npm with Next.js built-in build system
test_framework: N/A - greenfield project, no tests initially
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm install to install dependencies. 2. Run npm run build to verify the project compiles. 3. Run npm run lint to check for linting errors.
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/empty-repo. 2. npx create-next-app@latest . --typescript --tailwind --eslint --app --src-dir --import-alias '@/*' --use-npm (or manual setup). 3. npm install additional dependencies.
environment_constraints: Node.js v22.22.3, npm 11.4.2. OPEN_INTERNET network mode - full access to npm registry and external APIs. No Docker needed - target is Vercel free tier deployment.
key_patterns: Next.js App Router with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, server components by default, client components where needed for interactivity
directory_structure: Empty repo with only .gitignore and README.md. Will scaffold a Next.js project with src/ directory structure.
